place_name: Granite Park Spire, Granite Park (Pine Creek / Italy Pass), High Sierra, CA
approach_stated: About 8 miles with ~4,300 ft gain from Pine Creek Trailhead via unmaintained Italy Pass trail
summit_or_glacier: Summit: 700-ft spire, summit above 12,800 ft

evidence.fact: From Pine Creek Trailhead toward Honeymoon Lake then Italy Pass trail; approach about 8 miles, ~4,300 ft gain.
Trad, Alpine, 650 ft, 6 pitches, Grade III; 'the long approach' keeps crowds away; tops out on the spire.

place_name: The Citadel, Le Conte Canyon / Ladder Creek, Kings Canyon NP (Bishop Pass), CA
approach_stated: Bishop Pass Trail 12.5 miles from South Lake to Le Conte Canyon, then a couple miles on the JMT and up Ladder Creek
summit_or_glacier: Summit: Wild Kingdom tops out on the East Summit, descent from West Summit

evidence.fact: From South Lake trailhead hike the Bishop Pass Trail 12.5 miles to Le Conte Canyon, then JMT south a couple of miles.
Trad, Alpine, 1700 ft, 16 pitches, Grade IV; tops out on East Summit, descends West Summit's west ridge.

place_name: Junk Show Pinnacle, Alpine Lite Cliffs, Mt. Blue Sky (Evans), CO
approach_stated: Pullout near mile marker 8 on the Mt Blue Sky road, ~0.2 mi to the Warren-Rogers saddle, then a 20 minute walk to the cliffs
summit_or_glacier: Small pinnacle top only (2 pitches, 300 ft); no glacier; road-accessible

evidence.fact: Park at pullout near mile marker 8; about 0.2 miles to saddle; cliffs are a 20 minute walk over the saddle.
Trad, Alpine, 300 ft, 2 pitches; ends on a small pinnacle summit; down-led to the northeast.

note: High-altitude roadside crag; pinnacle top is not a mountain summit. Road needs a timed-entry reservation.

place_name: Reign of Women, Grand Turk, San Juans (south of Silverton, US 550), CO
approach_stated: No time or miles; cross-country from a US 550 dirt road through benches to a camp, then up a grassy slope to a notch and down to the face
summit_or_glacier: Face on Grand Turk (area elevation 13,037 ft); summit finish not stated

evidence.fact: From US 550 dirt road, navigate scarps/game trails to meadows; good camping after the last bench; from camp climb to a notch.
Trad, Alpine, 3 pitches, 170 ft; area Reign of Women on Grand Turk.

note: Approach time not quantified; verdict rests on a multi-stage off-trail approach past a camp at ~13,000 ft (mountain setting). Weaker than the others.

place_name: Mount Toll, Indian Peaks, CO
approach_stated: About 2 to 2 1/2 h (route page; approach as for North Ridge)
summit_or_glacier: Finishes ~200 ft below the Mt Toll summit

evidence.fact: Trad, Alpine, 600 ft, 4 pitches, Grade II; approach about 2 to 2 1/2 h; last pitch ends just below the summit.

place_name: Wilson Peak (14,017 ft), San Miguel Mountains, CO
approach_stated: Wilson Mesa Trail 2.2 mi + Lizard Head Trail 0.5 mi, then uphill through woods; 2,250 ft gain in one mile from treeline
summit_or_glacier: Summit: NNE ridge to the 14,017 ft summit

evidence.fact: Trad, Alpine, 1500 ft, Grade IV; Wilson Mesa Trail 2.2 mi, Lizard Head Trail 1/2 mi, ridge to the 14,017' summit.

place_name: Compensation Crag, Empire (US 40 north of Empire), CO
approach_stated: No time stated: 'just down to the left, below Al Cap'; Al Cap = pullout 3.1 mi outside Empire, then descend left to the base
summit_or_glacier: No summit or glacier; 40-ft single-pitch sport route beside the road

evidence.fact: Directions as for Al Cap; found just down to the left below Al Cap. Elevation 9,500 ft.
3.1 miles outside Empire park at the creek-side pullout; descend left to get to the base. No walking time.
Sport, Alpine, 40 ft single pitch.

note: Directions describe a roadside crag, but no minutes or distance are stated. Very likely crag.

place_name: Sakkety Point, Gore Range (Arapaho NF, near Latigo Ranch), CO
approach_stated: 'Hike a few minutes through the forest due east from the forest service road'
summit_or_glacier: No; 30-90 ft cliffs at 8,967 ft

evidence.fact: Forest Service approach: hike a few minutes due east from the forest service road; cliffs 30 to 90 feet; 8,967 ft.
Trad, TR, Alpine, 30 ft.

note: Shortest trail crosses Latigo Ranch (permission needed).

place_name: Forsaken Tower, Lost Meadow Crags, RMNP (North Fork Big Thompson), CO
approach_stated: About 8 miles from Dunraven Trailhead to Lost Meadow campsite (backcountry permit), then a bushwhack and moraine to the base
summit_or_glacier: Tower; roadless backcountry

evidence.fact: Dunraven Trailhead, about 8 miles to Lost Meadow Campsite; backcountry permits required; bushwhack and moraine to base.
Hike north from the west end of the campsite, then traverse right along the base of the climbs.

place_name: Chimney Rock (11,781 ft), Owl Creek Pass, Uncompahgre Wilderness, CO
approach_stated: No time; trailhead in the West Fork drainage below the rock, then steep ground and unavoidable 5th-class scrambling to the ridge
summit_or_glacier: Summit: optional 4th pitch traverses to the summit; summit rap ring

evidence.fact: Trad, Alpine, 4 pitches, Grade III; 5th class scrambling to ridge; optional 4th pitch traverses to the summit.
Owl Creek Pass road 15.8 miles, then West Fork 1.6 miles; trailhead below Chimney Rock; no hiking time given.

note: Verdict rests on the summit finish; approach time not stated. MP grades it 5.7 R.

place_name: James Peak, Indian Peaks (via St. Mary's Glacier), CO
approach_stated: No time; from the top of St. Mary's Glacier across alpine meadow into the east cirque, then scree to the bowl
summit_or_glacier: Snow couloir; exits onto the NE ridge ~400 yards from the summit

evidence.fact: Trad, Snow, Alpine, Grade II; approach from top of St. Mary's Glacier; couloir may be snow filled; ~400 yards to top.

place_name: Mears Peak, Sneffels Range (West Dallas Creek), CO
approach_stated: About 2 1/2 miles south through blowdown-choked woods from the end of West Dallas Creek Road; start very early or bivy near treeline
summit_or_glacier: Summit: West summit then scramble to the higher East summit

evidence.fact: Trad, Alpine, 1500 ft, Grade IV; navigate south about 2 1/2 miles to the North Ridge; finish on East summit.

place_name: Otis Power Tower (the Momento), Otis Peak, RMNP (Andrews Glacier trail), CO
approach_stated: No miles or time; hike from Glacier Gorge Trailhead to the Andrews Glacier trail; tower at 12,452 ft west of Piton Spire
summit_or_glacier: Tower on Otis Peak at 12,452 ft above the Andrews Glacier trail

evidence.fact: Hike from Glacier Gorge Trailhead to the Andrews Glacier trail; tower west of Piton Spire; elevation 12,452 ft.
Trad, Alpine, 600 ft, 5 pitches, Grade III; two double-rope raps then descend the gully.

note: Approach time not stated; verdict from high cirque setting on the Andrews Glacier trail and Grade III.

place_name: Mount Silverthorne / Zodiac Ridge towers, Gore Range, CO
approach_stated: No time; shuttle from Buffalo Mtn TH (Silverthorne) to Gore/Deluge TH (East Vail), or Willowbrook Rd TH for the towers only
summit_or_glacier: Ridge traverse of nine towers, optional summits of Mt Silverthorne / East Thorne

evidence.fact: Trad, Alpine, 6000 ft, Grade III; ridge traverse of nine named towers between trailheads in Silverthorne and East Vail.

place_name: Peak 12,878, Indian Peaks (south of Pawnee Pass), CO
approach_stated: No miles or time; 'Hike south from Pawnee Pass on Pawnee Pass Trail', passed on the way to the Chessmen on Apache Peak
summit_or_glacier: Pinnacle on an alpine peak (12,878 ft); summit finish not stated

evidence.fact: An alpine peak in the Indian Peaks Wilderness with an inviting pinnacle; hike south from Pawnee Pass.

note: Approach time not stated; verdict from a start beyond Pawnee Pass (high pass, roadless).

place_name: Bigger Bagger Pinnacle, Pikes Peak (up and right of the Pericle), CO
approach_stated: Nothing stated: 'To be edited in'; lower drainage is private, longer legal approaches exist
summit_or_glacier: Pinnacle at 12,458 ft on Pikes Peak; route ends at boulders, rappels

evidence.fact: Getting There 'To be edited in'; elevation 12,458 ft; lower drainage is private; longer legal approaches exist.
Trad, Alpine, 500 ft, 4 pitches, Grade III; access to this subarea can be challenging.

note: Pikes Peak area page gives only the toll road (19 mi to summit). Mountain setting, likely alpine, but no approach stated.

place_name: Mt. Zirkel, Mica Basin, Mt. Zirkel Wilderness, CO
approach_stated: No miles or time; from Slavonia on the Gilpin Trail to the Gilpin Creek crossing, faint trail to a pond below the Zirkel-Agnes saddle, over the saddle
summit_or_glacier: Summit: follow the ridge to the summit

evidence.fact: Trad, Alpine, 1300 ft, 11 pitches, Grade III; hike in from Slavonia on Gilpin Trail; ridge to summit.

place_name: Lion's Head West Face, Selkirk Crest (Priest Lake), ID
approach_stated: From the switchback on Forest Road #44, flagged path: ~15 min steep uphill plus ~15 min to the talus below Lion's Head West Peak (~30 min)
summit_or_glacier: Not stated; face on Lion's Head West Peak (area elevation 7,027 ft); no glacier

evidence.fact: Park at switchback on Road #44; about 15 minutes steep uphill, then about 15 more minutes to the talus field below West Peak.
Follow directions for Lion's Head. Elevation 7,027 ft.
Trad, Alpine, 3 pitches; no summit or descent described.

note: Whether the route tops out on the West Peak summit is not stated; the ~30 min approach (+ talus) makes it a crag by the owner rule.

place_name: Chipmunk Perch, Saddleback Lakes, Sawtooth Range (Redfish Lake), ID
approach_stated: Same as Elephant's Perch: 5-mile boat ride across Redfish Lake (or hike around), then ~2 mi on trail and a steep climbers' trail; Elephant's Perch page: steep 3-mile hike to camp
summit_or_glacier: Not stated; 14-pitch Grade route at 9,900 ft; roadless

evidence.fact: Approach same as Elephant's Perch: far end of Redfish Lake, about two miles of trail, then unmarked climbers' trail. 9,900 ft.
5-mile boat ride across Redfish Lake, then a steep 3-mile hike to camping below the Perch near Saddleback Lakes.

note: Not road-accessible (boat or long lakeshore hike); 1500 ft, 14 pitches.

place_name: GFC Wall, Cedar Creek, Lost River Range (near Challis), ID
approach_stated: No time: road ends ~2.5 mi in; faint trail along the drainage; GFC Wall is the first developed crag on the Main Wall approach
summit_or_glacier: No; 30-ft sport route belayed from the trail

evidence.fact: The first developed crags reached on the Main Wall approach; trail passes under the overhang; belay from the trail.
Road ends at approx 2.5 miles where you park; faint cairned trail on south side of the drainage. No hiking time.
Sport, Alpine, 30 ft.

note: Single-pitch sport on a trail near the road; very likely crag but no time/distance stated.

place_name: Super Slab, Sawtooth Range (Redfish Lake inlet trail), ID
approach_stated: As for Elephant's Perch: across Redfish Lake (5-mile boat ride or hike around), then almost 2 miles to boardwalks and a social trail up to the slabs
summit_or_glacier: No summit; ends at trees, walk off right

evidence.fact: Approach as for Elephant's Perch; almost 2 miles past Redfish Lake, cross boardwalks, faint social trail up to slabs.
Trad, Alpine, 5 pitches, Grade II; ends at trees; walk off right back to packs.
Reaching the far end of Redfish Lake takes a 5-mile boat ride, or a hike around the lake.

note: Borderline: from the boat dock it is ~2 mi, but the car is across a 5-mile lake (no road). Called alpine as roadless; could be unsure.

place_name: Gunsight Peak North Face, Selkirk Crest, ID
approach_stated: No trail; preferred Roothaan route 4.5 miles, 4-5 hours with a heavy pack, '3 hours or less' light
summit_or_glacier: Peak face (6,847 ft); route tops out right of Oka-Bates; summit not stated

evidence.fact: No defined trail; Roothaan approach 4.5 miles; 4-5 hours with a heavy pack, 3 hours or less going light.
Trad, Aid, Alpine, 500 ft, 4 pitches, Grade III; reach North Face down a ridge, notch and ramp.

place_name: Klondike Pond cliff, Katahdin / Baxter State Park, ME
approach_stated: 'No Trail accesses the base'; off-trail from the Northwest Basin Trail near Caribou Spring, ~1 mile W of Hamlin Peak; no time stated
summit_or_glacier: Roadless backcountry cliff in the Klondike; route scrambles to top of cliff

evidence.fact: No trail accesses the base; drop into the basin from the Northwest Basin Trail near Caribou Spring; about 1 mile west of Hamlin Peak.
Trad, Alpine, 300 ft, 3 pitches, Grade II; grade 5.6 is an educated guess.

note: Approach time not stated; verdict from roadless off-trail setting near Hamlin Peak.

place_name: Mill Creek Wilderness Boundary, Mill Creek (Bitterroot, Missoula area), MT
approach_stated: About 5 miles up the Mill Creek Trail, then 22-26 minutes up from the creek trail
summit_or_glacier: No summit/glacier stated; 85-ft single-pitch route

evidence.fact: About 5 miles up the Mill Creek Trail; up 22-26 minutes from the creek trail.

note: Long backcountry approach (>60 min) for a single-pitch crag; alpine by the owner's approach rule.
